name: av_forex_rate
description:
Current exchange rate for one currency pair from Alpha Vantage (CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE); also works for crypto codes such as BTC.
Returns: {"Realtime Currency Exchange Rate": {From_Currency Code, To_Currency Code, Exchange Rate, Last Refreshed, Time Zone, Bid Price, Ask Price}} as strings.
Inputs (* required): from (ISO currency code; default EUR); to (ISO currency code; default USD).
History: av_forex_daily, av_forex_weekly, yf_forex_history, openbb_forex_historical.
Example: {"from": "GBP", "to": "JPY"}
